task_completion.description: Open pEGFP-C1.gb and MAP1LC3B.gb in UGENE
task_completion.visual_evidence: UGENE window showing both pEGFP-C1.gb and MAP1LC3B.gb loaded in the Project View or Sequence View.

task_completion.description: Identify and extract the EGFP CDS sequence from pEGFP-C1
task_completion.visual_evidence: Selection of the EGFP CDS feature in the UGENE sequence view or a separate tab showing the extracted EGFP sequence.

task_completion.description: Remove the stop codon from the EGFP CDS sequence
task_completion.visual_evidence: Sequence editor showing the deletion of the final 3 nucleotides (TAG/TAA/TGA) of the EGFP sequence or a concatenation step where the stop codon is excluded.

task_completion.description: Concatenate EGFP (no stop) with the full MAP1LC3B CDS in-frame
task_completion.visual_evidence: UGENE 'Build Sequence' dialog or manual sequence editing showing the joining of the two sequences into a single continuous strand.

task_completion.description: Save the fusion nucleotide sequence to egfp_lc3b_fusion.fasta
task_completion.visual_evidence: Save dialog or file explorer showing egfp_lc3b_fusion.fasta created in ~/UGENE_Data/fusion_design/results/.

task_completion.description: Translate the fusion sequence and save to egfp_lc3b_protein.fasta
task_completion.visual_evidence: UGENE translation tool output or a protein sequence file showing the translated amino acids saved to the results folder.

task_completion.description: Create fusion_report.txt with required lengths and stop codon confirmation
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or UGENE document viewer showing fusion_report.txt with 4 specific lengths and a statement about internal stop codons.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE GUI for sequence manipulation rather than just terminal commands
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show interaction with UGENE menus, sequence views, and dialog boxes.

integrity.description: The agent derived lengths from the software rather than guessing
integrity.visual_evidence: The report values match the sequence lengths displayed in the UGENE status bar or property panel for the selected sequences.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename existing files in the results folder
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the active construction and saving process of the fusion sequence.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The pEGFP-C1 CDS (U55763.1) is 798 bp long (including the MCS). The MAP1LC3B CDS (NM_022818.5) is 378 bp long. The final fusion nucleotide sequence (EGFP CDS minus 3bp stop + MAP1LC3B CDS) should be 795 + 378 = 1173 bp. The final protein length should be 391 aa. There should be no internal stop codons if the fusion is correctly in-frame.
